spots.name: Diolch Jess
spots.blurb: You've reached Diolch Jess, a mural by Regan Gilflin;UNIFY from 2025. A portrait of Welsh international footballer Jess Fishlock while running, on a green background, with the words "Diolch Jess" ("Thank you Jess") above her and the Adidas logo both in white below. Basketball and five-a-side football markings are in yellow.
